title: World ID 4.0 production proxies, owners and admin authority
summary: Resolve the live World ID 4.0 production deployment and identify proxy owners, multisigs, signer thresholds, privileged relayers and legal/operational control without guessing wallet ownership.

data.query: What are the live World ID 4.0 production proxies and privileged-role addresses, and who legally and operationally controls their owners, multisigs, relayers and emergency keys?
data.research_question: What are the live World ID 4.0 production proxies and privileged-role addresses, and who legally and operationally controls their owners, multisigs, relayers and emergency keys?
objectives: Recover canonical production proxy, implementation, registry and bridge addresses from first-party deployment records.
Resolve current on-chain owners, operators, fee recipients, upgrade roles and emergency controls.
Attribute multisigs, signer thresholds and operational/legal controller identities only where primary or independently corroborated evidence supports the attribution.
Recover upgrade, emergency and key-rotation history with effective dates.
preferred_sources: verified contract source and canonical explorers
